meta.name: Gunaah 2024
meta.description:
Betrayed by loved ones, the world around Shiva shattered! Taking a new identity as Abhimanyu, he endures many trials for a bloody vengeance, carved with love.

Rated U/A 16+ · Returning Series · First aired 3 Jun 2024 · India · Language: Hindi
Studio: Bodhi Tree Multimedia · Network: Disney+ Hotstar

Complete series. On your server: S1 25/25 | S2 20/20

On your server — Audio: Hindi

videos.title: Hell Hath No Fury Like a Man Wronged!
videos.overview: Ready to settle a score, big shot Abhimanyu Nayak arrives in Goa. Back in the past, Shiva’s reunion with his BFF gang ignites the chapter of love, lies and deceit.

videos.title: The Vendetta
videos.overview: At the casino, Abhimanyu weighs in on his first move. Flashbacks reveal how a romantic date night draws Shiva into a deadly web as he gets framed for a murder.

videos.title: Tables Have Turned
videos.overview: The aftereffects of his arrest leave Shiva reeling with frame-ups and betrayals. While Tara wrestles with painful memories of her own, Abhimanyu takes charge at the casino.

videos.title: My Love Is Not a Lie
videos.overview: With her son Kartik missing, a frail and frightened Tara begins the search.  A look into the past offers Tara’s side of the love story, unveiling disturbing secrets.

videos.title: D-Day
videos.overview: Armed with the ‘perfect heist’ plan, Michael, JK, and Tara brace for their next moves. Ahead of a charity event, Abhimanyu and Michael get into a heated confrontation.

videos.title: The Godfather
videos.overview: While Shiva is left grilling in prison, his friends-turned-foes start anew after a successful heist. Amidst the uncertainty, Shiva finds his guiding light in the form of Bhau.

videos.title: Best Served Cold
videos.overview: Conflicts of the past resurface as Abhimanyu and JK have a man-to-man conversation. Drowned in his sorrows, Shiva has one choice to make: give up or retaliate!

videos.title: Reincarnation
videos.overview: At Tara’s party, Abhimanyu concocts his plan of action. In the past, Bhau’s orchestrated mayhem offers Shiva a second chance at life - a rebirth!

videos.title: We Are Family
videos.overview: While Tara grows frantic about Divya’s deteriorating health, Abhimanyu reminisces the sufferings of his loved ones. At the prison, a plot to kill Bhau is set in motion.

videos.title: A Way Back Home
videos.overview: Tension mounts between JK and the Ranes over reopening Shiva’s case. Back home, Abhimanyu finds solace in his father’s embrace. And now, he is all set for his next move!

videos.title: Is Love a Trap?
videos.overview: Flashbacks reveal how love becomes a hurdle in Abhimanyu’s plan of vengeance. As he storms into Tara’s life again, the resolution for revenge is clear - one way or another!

videos.title: The Loophole
videos.overview: Looking for answers, Michael dredges up Abhimanyu’s close associate Rana’s story. While he aims to connect the dots, Abhimanyu forms an unlikely bond with Divya.

videos.title: Men with a Past!
videos.overview: While Abhimanyu and Rana deal with the ghosts of their past, Divya wrestles with her feelings of love. At the casino, Abhimanyu senses an opportunity to get back at Tara.

videos.title: Of Lost Love and Vengeance
videos.overview: Tension simmers as Abhimanyu pushes Tara to recall the past wounds. While Gargi senses a conspiracy, Abhimanyu answers a big question: What after revenge?

videos.title: A Mother's Heart
videos.overview: With Gargi’s arrival at the dinner party, Abhimanyu’s identity is at risk of disclosure. Following his hunch, Michael inches dangerously close to the truth.

videos.title: Fate Is Blind
videos.overview: Bhau warns Abhimanyu to lay low! JK-Gargi-Abhimanyu’s confrontation at the Rane house dredges up past wounds, new revelations, and changing destinies.

videos.title: The Gameplan
videos.overview: A crucial intel about Abhimanyu makes JK plot his next moves. Meanwhile, Abhimanyu’s growing bond with Tara and Divya spirals into emotional turmoil.

videos.title: Show of Power
videos.overview: While Bhau guides Abhimanyu on his next plan of action, JK sets his sights on Abhimanyu’s hotel project. A deadly attack at Tara’s casino puts everyone on edge!

videos.title: The Night I Met You Again
videos.overview: After the casino attack, JK and Abhimanyu seek shelter at the old-yet-familiar Adda. Broken from within, Tara finds solace in a heart-to-heart talk with Abhimanyu.

videos.title: Blood Ties
videos.overview: Tara grows increasingly concerned when Michael claims to have killed her father. Back at the Rane house, Abhimanyu reminisces painful memories of the past.

videos.title: Follow the Commander
videos.overview: Abhimanyu keeps things platonic with Divya while Michael’s quest for the truth intensifies. Keeping Abhimanyu out of the loop, Bhau sets a new plan in motion.

videos.title: Can I Get Over Her?
videos.overview: JK overlooks Michael’s findings about Abhimanyu. Back at the casino, JK’s revelation about wanting a second child leaves Abhimanyu wrestling with pent-up feelings.

videos.title: Innocent Love
videos.overview: Michael presses on JK’s insecurity, sowing doubts about Kartik’s biological father. While Divya revels in new-found love, Abhimanyu must reconsider his immoral choices.

videos.title: Cheaters Will Prosper
videos.overview: DNA findings reveal the truth about Kartik’s parentage, leaving JK on edge. Ready to get back at Tara, Abhimanyu remains persistent about his love trap for Divya.

videos.title: There Will Be Blood
videos.overview: Using Divya as a pawn, Abhimanyu wrestles with a tough choice - act or retreat. Ahead of the D-day, an unexpected tragedy awaits everyone. And this may ruin it all!

videos.title: Why Did You Betray Me?
videos.overview: Forging a business partnership with JK and Tara, Abhimanyu makes it clear - the vendetta will continue! Determined to unravel the conspiracy, Mert embarks on a quest of his own.

videos.title: Don’t Dig Your Own Grave!
videos.overview: Mert’s quest to clear Shiva’s name brings him to the jail, where he discovers a crucial intel. As he gets dangerously close to the truth, Bhau takes matters into his own hands.

videos.title: Let Me Tell You A Story…
videos.overview: To thwart Mert’s investigation, Bhau orchestrates a calculated move. Tara’s world crumbles after finding a videotape that reveals what unfolded on the night of the bank robbery.

videos.title: My Love Is A Lie
videos.overview: Hit hard by reality, Tara tries to retrospect and seeks refuge at Gargi’s house. While Michael closes in on Bhau, Abhimanyu clears the truth about his growing closeness to Tara.

videos.title: My Brother Is A Murderer!
videos.overview: Seizing an opportunity, Abhimanyu manages to create a rift between Tara and JK. Things spiral out of control when Mert publishes an article naming Shiva as the murderer.

videos.title: The Castle Is Falling
videos.overview: A well-timed strategy helps Abhimanyu sow seeds of mistrust between JK and Michael. As old connections begin to alter, he sets his sights on the next target - Tara.

videos.title: My Game, My Rules
videos.overview: The old player—RC—rises to power, using the videotape to secure control over JK and Michael. Meanwhile, Abhimanyu puts the final touches on his plan to take over Tara’s casinos!

videos.title: Your Love Is My Solace
videos.overview: Tara wrestles with her growing feelings for Abhimanyu, unknowingly falling for his trap. The trio—RC, Michael, and JK—reflect on setting a ploy for Abhimanyu.

videos.title: Will You Die For Your Brother?
videos.overview: Revenge is his only motto! A new threat looms over the Rane house with Pakya’s arrival. The truth about Tara and RC’s relationship makes Abhimanyu reconsider his plan.

videos.title: It’s a Devil’s World
videos.overview: All the pieces fall into place as Pakya gets his hands on the videotape. But a tragedy befalls, pushing Abhimanyu and everyone to the edge. And this may change it all!

videos.title: I Embrace Death!
videos.overview: Ready to bury his past once and for all, Abhimanyu declares the death of Shiva. Tension flares as Tara receives an anonymous call—Kartik has been kidnapped!

videos.title: Time’s Ticking On You
videos.overview: Amid mounting pressure, Bhau assigns JK a critical task to save Kartik. And a trap is laid! JK runs into trouble with the police after getting framed at a crime scene.

videos.title: Let’s Rewind The Clock
videos.overview: Using Tara as the pawn, Abhimanyu inches closer to put an end to the JK chapter. A tense scene unfolds in the courtroom as Tara testifies against JK. And Karma hits back!

videos.title: All Eyes On You
videos.overview: The intimate picture of Abhimanyu and Tara makes everything clear. While Michael readies to expose him, Divya’s world comes crashing down. A big setback looms over Abhimanyu!

videos.title: I Am The Destroyer!
videos.overview: Revelations and regrets surface! Tara wrestles with her past and present choices after a fallout with Divya. At the jail, Abhimanyu confronts JK and reveals it all.

videos.title: Only Innocents Will Suffer
videos.overview: A sudden tragedy pushes Tara on the edge, while JK faces an unexpected visitor. Abhimanyu proposes marriage to Tara, which hints at a new turning point!
